# fct_advisor_events_participation_advisors

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_advisor_events_participation_advisors` · dbt area: `advisor_events`

Fact table of advisor participation in FAM trips and Splash events. Each row is one advisor-event combination with data such as participation status (RSVP, check-in) or the registration timestamp.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `event_participation_advisor_id` | A unique identifier for a participant, linked to a specific event. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `advisor_id` | The participating advisor's ID. SOURCE >> Portal |
| `certification_at_event_start_date` | The Advisor's estimated certification level when the event started. NOTE - This field can cause duplicate counts (if combining multiple dates, such as in a year, an Advisor might have been multiple levels. BOTH will be counted!) >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `event_id` | The unique ID for an event. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
| `participant_status` | The participant's RSVP status for an event (e/g invited, attending, etc.). >> SOURCE - Splash via Google Sheets |
| `registered_at` | The time a participant registered (marked RSVP Yes) to an event. SOURCE >> Splash via Google Sheets |
